name: agency-intake-kit
description: Root scripts only. No dependencies here, so there is no root lockfile.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:engine && npm run verify:dashboard
scripts.verify:engine: cd engine && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src && uv run pytest -q
scripts.verify:dashboard: cd dashboard && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.demo: cd engine && uv run intake run --in ../fixtures/agency-a/drop --out ../runs/demo --jev replay --as-of 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z --overwrite && cd .. && rm -rf dashboard/public/demo-run && mkdir -p dashboard/public/demo-run && cp -R runs/demo/manifest.json runs/demo/scorecard.json runs/demo/exceptions.jsonl runs/demo/rts_coverage.json runs/demo/tie_out runs/demo/report.html dashboard/public/demo-run/
scripts.shots: cd dashboard && npx playwright test e2e/shots.spec.ts
